proposal.title: Campaign timeline — International January 1982 promotional campaign
proposal.reason: Convert this campaign to an independent dated timeline object. Dates are resolved from its execution process without changing precision. Preserve all existing event/subprocess ownership; marketing-step reference_id is absent throughout. Consolidate presentations, campaign material and useful claim-policy requirements into narrated steps; remove historical acceptance labels and duplicate import fragments. Product-owned launch links remain authoritative and validated through the explicit transitional execution mapping.

before.title: International January 1982 promotional campaign
before.objective: Your local computer. A shared software future. Promote independently branded Artemis-compatible systems and their shared business workflows.
message: Run previews, translated press materials, coordinated January premiere, dealer roadshows and Academy workshops. Shared compatibility, national brands and supported business workflows are the campaign themes. Funding consists of AION shared materials and capped partner matching funds, with absolute costs pending assessment.
claim_policy: No automatic campaign uplift, shipment count or simultaneous SGS qualification is inferred.

marketing_steps.description: Coordinate previews, translated press materials and dealer readiness.

marketing_steps.description: Present independent national brands in the coordinated January launch.

marketing_presentation.description: International Logix-compatible launch — five manufacturers and Aion Tech UK

marketing_steps.description: Run dealer roadshows and Academy workshops through 31 March.

marketing_presentation.description: Run the coordinated previews, local dealer roadshows and Academy workshops through 31 March. Use AION-funded shared materials and capped partner matching funds, with absolute costs pending assessment; do not count promotional activity as automatic sales uplift.

marketing_steps.description: Assess the campaign and partner readiness at the 90-day review.

marketing_presentation.description: The coordinated multi-brand launch and promotional follow-up reach the 90-day partner review.
